requestDetails.title: Maintenance request details
requestDetails.description: Review all changes in this maintenance request and complete any required actions.
requestDetails.noActionRequired: No action is required from you right now.

entity.documentsDescription: Upload the required documents to continue.

organizationDetails.title: Business information
organizationDetails.description: Registered, contact, and operating information on the approved profile.

addParty.title: Add related party
addParty.description: Add a controller or beneficial owner to this maintenance request.
addParty.replacementDescription: Add the new controller first. After this person is saved, the current controller will be removed in the same maintenance request.
addParty.ownershipPathDescription: The intermediary was added. Confirm this owner's details to create the new indirect path before the old direct ownership record is retired.
addParty.beneficialOwnerDescription: Add a person who directly owns 25% or more of the business.
addParty.indirectOwnerDescription: Add the person who ultimately owns 25% or more through this intermediary business.
addParty.caption: Identity and ownership details
addParty.roleDescription: Choose the responsibility this person has for the business.

roleDescriptions.CONTROLLER: A person with significant responsibility for managing the business.
roleDescriptions.BENEFICIAL_OWNER: A person who owns 25% or more of the business, directly or indirectly.

addParty.identityDescription: Enter the person's legal information exactly as it appears on their identification.
addParty.identificationDescription: The available identification types depend on the person's country of residence.
addParty.idInvalid: Enter all 9 digits for an SSN or ITIN.
addParty.addressDescription: Enter the address where this person currently lives.
addParty.alsoBeneficialOwner: This person also owns 25% or more
addParty.alsoBeneficialOwnerDescription: The replacement will be created once with both Controller and Beneficial owner roles.
addParty.saveReplacement: Add replacement and remove current controller

removeParty.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeParty.description: This removal will be included in the maintenance request. The approved profile remains unchanged until review is complete.
removeParty.replacementDescription: A controller is required. Add a replacement to continue.
removeParty.replacementUnavailable: A replacement controller cannot be added under the current maintenance configuration. Contact support before removing this person.
removeParty.remainsOwnerQuestion: After the controller is replaced, will this person still own 25% or more?
removeParty.remainsOwnerYes: Yes, keep as a beneficial owner

roleChange.controllerDescription: The controller is the person responsible for this business profile.
roleChange.directOwnerDescription: This person owns 25% or more of the client business directly. No other business sits between the client and this owner.
roleChange.directRelationshipTitle: Is this ownership held through another business?
roleChange.directRelationshipDescription: If one or more businesses sit between the client and this owner, update the relationship to reflect the intermediary ownership path.
roleChange.indirectOwnerDescription: This person owns 25% or more of the client business through one or more intermediary businesses.
roleChange.indirectRelationshipDescription: This owner's interest is held through {{businesses}}.
roleChange.pendingAdditionDescription: This role and its ownership details are included in the current request. Removing it requires discarding all pending changes for this person.
roleChange.pendingRemovalDescription: This role remains active on the approved profile until its removal is approved.
roleChange.pendingPartyRoleDescription: This role will be added with the person when the maintenance request is approved.
roleChange.addOwnerDescription: {{name}} will remain the controller and will also be recorded as a direct beneficial owner.
roleChange.discardPartyDraft: Discard all pending changes for this person

pendingAddition.personDescription: This person will be added to the business profile when the maintenance request is approved.
pendingAddition.businessDescription: This intermediary business will be added to the ownership structure when the maintenance request is approved.
pendingAddition.description: This person's addition is pending and is not yet part of the approved business profile.
pendingAddition.reviewGuidance: Review the proposed details and complete any required documents before submitting the request.
pendingAddition.discardDescription: This person will not be added to the business profile. Other changes in the request will be preserved.

formExit.title: Discard this unsaved entry?
formExit.description: The information entered on this page has not been added to the maintenance request.

questions.title: Additional questions
questions.description: Answer the required questions so review can continue.
questions.emptyDescription: Return to review and try again. Submission remains unavailable until every requested question is returned.

attestation.title: Review and attest
attestation.description: Review each required document and confirm the information below.
attestation.documentsDescription: Open every document before entering the details of the person making this attestation.
attestation.signerDescription: Enter your legal name and your role at the business.
attestation.signerLocked: Review every required document to unlock signer details.
attestation.designationPlaceholder: For example, CEO, controller, or partner
attestation.designationDescription: Use your title or role at the business.
attestation.confirmation: I have reviewed the required documents and attest that the information is complete and accurate.

ownership.title: Ownership structure
ownership.description: Review qualifying owners and intermediary businesses. Update anything that is incomplete or incorrect.
ownership.beneficialOwnersDescription: Add each person who directly owns 25% or more. A controller who also owns 25% or more appears here as a beneficial owner.
ownership.pathPreviewDescription: First add the intermediary business. Next, confirm the owner beneath it. The current direct ownership record is retired only after the new path is complete.
ownership.insertIntermediaryDescription: Add the business that sits between the client and this owner. Next, confirm the owner's details under the new intermediary.
ownership.noDirectOwners: No direct beneficial owners are listed yet.
ownership.unifiedDescription: Each branch shows how an owner connects to the client. Indented owners hold their interest through the business above them; use the action on a person or business to change that branch.
ownership.previewDescription: A simplified view of direct owners and ownership held through other businesses.
ownership.chainDescription: Create each ownership layer from this business outward
ownership.businessIdentityDescription: Enter the intermediary's registered legal information.
ownership.unsupportedOrganizationId: This API contract only confirms US EIN support for intermediary owners. Choose the United States or contact support before continuing.
ownership.legalAddressDescription: Enter the address shown on the intermediary's registration documents.

ownerRelationship.title: Ownership relationship
ownerRelationship.addDescription: First choose whether this owner holds their interest directly or through an intermediary business.
ownerRelationship.controllerDescription: Choose how {{name}} holds their ownership interest.
ownerRelationship.changeDescription: Select the business that sits between your business and {{name}}, or add that business first.
ownerRelationship.directDescription: Choose this when no other business sits between the owner and the client.
ownerRelationship.indirectDescription: Choose this when the owner holds their interest through an intermediary company. Select an existing business below or add the intermediary first.
ownerRelationship.resultingPath: The owner will be added beneath this business.
ownerRelationship.changeExistingDescription: Choose where {{name}} holds their ownership interest.
ownerRelationship.changeAddBusiness: Add a new intermediary for this owner

controllerReplacement.title: Choose a replacement controller
controllerReplacement.description: Select an existing person who is directly related to this business, or add someone new.
controllerReplacement.existingDescription: Their current roles and profile details will be preserved.
controllerReplacement.emptyDescription: Add a new person to continue replacing the controller.

organizationForm.identityDescription: Use the legal names currently registered for this business.
organizationForm.editDescription: Update supported registered business details. Only fields that change are added to the request.
organizationForm.addressDescription: Submitting a new business address replaces the complete approved address. Review every line before saving.

productAddition.title: Add Limited DDA Payments
productAddition.description: Add payment capabilities to the existing Embedded Payments product.
productAddition.paymentsDescription: Adds payment capabilities alongside the existing Limited DDA sub-product.
productAddition.nextDescription: After you request Limited DDA Payments, it appears as a pending sub-product. You can review and update business, related-party, or ownership information before submitting all updates together for review.

availability.productAlreadyAdded: Limited DDA Payments is already part of this profile or request.
availability.requestLocked: New changes are unavailable while this maintenance request is being reviewed.
availability.productNotEligible: Limited DDA Payments is not configured for this business's country and legal entity type.
availability.originalProductPending: The original Limited DDA product must be approved before this product can be added.
availability.verificationRequired: Complete the original product verification before adding Limited DDA Payments.
availability.productLeadTime: Limited DDA Payments becomes available after {{time}}, once the five-minute verification window has passed.
availability.ownerLimit: This request already includes the maximum of four beneficial owners.
availability.limitedDdaHostAction: Limited DDA must be added through the onboarding experience before Limited DDA Payments is available.

submission.draftExplanation: Your pending changes are saved and have not been submitted for review.
submission.reviewDescription: Review the product update, business and related-party information, and ownership structure that will be submitted together.
submission.submittedChangesDescription: These are the changes currently under review.
submission.reviewUpdated: The pending changes were updated while you were reviewing them. Review the latest changes before confirming.
submission.ownershipDescription: Review every individual and intermediary business that owns 25% or more.
submission.blockedDescription: Complete the required items shown above before submitting these updates.
submission.blockedGuidance: The confirmation controls and Submit for review button will become available when every requirement is complete.
submission.lockWarning: Submitting sends the product update and all maintenance changes together for review. You will not be able to edit or discard them after submission.
submission.confirmationDescription: Use the edit actions or return to the business profile if anything needs to change. Required attestation documents are completed separately.
submission.informationConfirmation: I reviewed the business and related-party information on file, including the updates shown here, and confirm no other changes are needed.
submission.ownershipConfirmation: I reviewed the ownership structure and confirm it includes every individual and intermediary business that owns 25% or more.
submission.confirmation: I confirm that I reviewed all changes and they are complete and accurate.
submission.receiptDescription: Your changes were accepted for review on {{date}}.
submission.profileRemainsActive: Your current profile remains active while the changes are reviewed.
submission.receiptNextDescription: The request is accepted for review, not yet approved. After approval, updated profile values may take 24 to 48 hours to appear.
submission.receiptLeave: You can safely leave this page and return to the business profile to check the request status.

nameEditor.editDescription: Update identity, residence, responsibility, and contact details. Only fields that change are added to the request.

nameEditor.noChanges: Change at least one name field before saving.
